title: Nebius reports second quarter 2026 financial results
publisher: Nebius Group N.V. via the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission
excerpt: Nebius reported Q2 revenue of USD 582.3 million, adjusted EBITDA of USD 236.2 million, and USD 5.6574 billion of purchases of property, equipment and intangible assets.
summary: The SEC-filed issuer release reports 454% year-over-year Q2 revenue growth and positive adjusted EBITDA, alongside exceptional capital intensity, USD 102.5 million of share-based compensation, USD 8.0421 billion cash, USD 8.5457 billion debt, and 271,855,218 issued and outstanding shares at June 30.
